cards.issue_title: Explore banks asks for today’s numbers instead of showing what to change to save money
summary_4_lines: On Explore banks they walked the loan form (income, property, credit score, age) and restated the same complaint.
They do not want the site to tell them what the “best” numbers should be.
They want it to show what a person could change — wait months, raise the score, switch salaried vs self-employed, put a younger wife’s name on the loan — and how much that would save.
That talk was unfinished here and continues in the next recording.
cards.pinpoint: On Explore banks, the Loan inputs card currently collects the user’s present figures to list matching banks; they said that is the wrong job because they want change-this-to-save-that advice, not a prescription of the best parameters.
cards.on_screen_object: Loan inputs form on Explore banks (Monthly income #hlc-monthly-income, Property agreement value #hlc-property-value, CIBIL score #hlc-cibil, Age #hlc-age, Occupation Salaried/Self-employed, co-applicant under Adjust eligibility)
quotes_sample: Actually, I don't want you to tell me what the best parameters should be.
If you tell me that salary is more than self-employed, then I will remove my pay slip.
If you have taken your wife's name, then you have saved Rs. 400,000.
related_discussion_one_liners: Restatement opener: “I will say everything once again”; main purpose named as monthly income; “the values here should already be met”; “I was looking at this tool.” Fields were already filled; they cleared Monthly income and typed 1,00,000 — treat as restating that the form should already have values, not a second empty-field defect.

User-gaming examples of the wanted job: wait six months for a stated loan amount; take a small loan so things become “perfect”; find a “credit agency” to raise the score; if salaried beats self-employed, change how income is shown (raw ASR “remove my pay slip”; next recording says get a payslip / join a company); age 30 “not good,” wife 28, “I will take her name.”
They contrasted a loan that is “perfect for me” with saving a large rupee amount even with a “high civil score” by adding the wife’s name.
They did not attack layout, the black recorder masks on bank rows, the low-looking property figure, See options, Apply once, or Filters as separate problems in this recording.
